result.summary: 本文提出了 Transformer，一种完全基于注意力机制、摒弃循环和卷积的序列转换网络架构 [S1.p4]。作者在 WMT 2014 英德和英法机器翻译任务上验证该模型，英德任务上 big 模型取得 28.4 BLEU，超过此前最佳结果（包括集成模型）2 BLEU 以上 [S6.SS1.p1]；英法任务上 big 模型取得 41.0 BLEU，超过所有此前发表的单模型 [S6.SS1.p2]。作者还将 Transformer 应用于英语成分句法分析，表明其能泛化到其他任务 [S6.SS3.p1]。

research_question.text: 循环模型沿输入输出序列的符号位置分解计算，这种固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。注意力机制已成为序列建模和转换模型的重要组成部分，但在大多数情况下仍与循环网络结合使用 [S1.p3]。本文旨在提出一种完全依赖注意力机制、摒弃循环的模型架构 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths
In all but a few cases, however, such attention mechanisms are used in conjunction with a recurrent network.
In this work we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism

method.text: Transformer 采用编码器-解码器结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成，每层包含多头自注意力子层和逐位置全连接前馈网络，并采用残差连接加层归一化 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。注意力采用缩放点积注意力，即对 query 与所有 key 的点积除以 sqrt(d_k) 后经 softmax 得到权重，再对 value 加权求和 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1][S3.SS2.SSS1.p3]。模型使用 h=8 个并行注意力头，每个头维度为 d_k=d_v=d_model/h=64 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p5]。由于模型不含循环和卷积，作者在输入嵌入中加入正弦余弦位置编码以利用序列顺序信息 [S3.SS5.p1][S3.SS5.p2]。

evidence.quote: The encoder is composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers. Each layer has two sub-layers.
The decoder is also composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by $\sqrt{d_{k}}$, and apply a softmax function
In this work we employ $h=8$ parallel attention layers, or heads.
we must inject some information about the relative or absolute position of the tokens in the sequence
In this work, we use sine and cosine functions of different frequencies:

experiments.text: 作者在 WMT 2014 英德数据集（约 450 万句对，共享 BPE 词表约 37000 词）和 WMT 2014 英法数据集（3600 万句，32000 word-piece 词表）上训练模型 [S5.SS1.p1]。训练使用 8 块 NVIDIA P100 GPU，base 模型训练 100,000 步约 12 小时，big 模型训练 300,000 步约 3.5 天 [S5.SS2.p1]。此外，作者在 Penn Treebank 的 WSJ 部分（约 40K 训练句）以及半监督设置（约 17M 句）上进行了英语成分句法分析实验 [S6.SS3.p2]。

evidence.quote: We trained on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs.
For English-French, we used the significantly larger WMT 2014 English-French dataset consisting of 36M sentences
We trained our models on one machine with 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs.
We trained the base models for a total of 100,000 steps or 12 hours.
We trained a 4-layer transformer with $d_{model}=1024$ on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) portion of the Penn Treebank, about 40K training sentences.

findings.text: 在 WMT 2014 英德翻译任务上，big 模型超过此前最佳模型（包括集成模型）2.0 BLEU 以上，取得 28.4 BLEU 的新最优成绩 [S6.SS1.p1]。在 WMT 2014 英法任务上，big 模型取得 41.0 BLEU，超过所有此前发表的单模型，训练成本不到此前最优模型的 1/4 [S6.SS1.p2]。模型变体实验表明，单头注意力比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多也会导致质量下降 [S6.SS2.p2]；减小注意力 key 维度 d_k 会损害模型质量 [S6.SS2.p3]；用学习式位置嵌入替换正弦位置编码得到几乎相同的结果 [S6.SS2.p3]。在英语成分句法分析上，Transformer 在仅使用 WSJ 40K 句训练时也超过 BerkeleyParser [S6.SS3.p5]。

evidence.quote: outperforms the best previously reported models (including ensembles) by more than $2.0$ BLEU, establishing a new state-of-the-art BLEU score of $28.4$
our big model achieves a BLEU score of $41.0$, outperforming all of the previously published single models
While single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads.
we observe that reducing the attention key size $d_{k}$ hurts model quality
we replace our sinusoidal positional encoding with learned positional embeddings, and observe nearly identical results
the Transformer outperforms the BerkeleyParser even when training only on the WSJ training set of 40K sentences.

limitations.text: 作者指出，将自注意力限制在输入序列中以相应输出位置为中心的邻域大小 r，可将最大路径长度增至 O(n/r)，并计划在未来工作中进一步研究该方法 [S4.p4]。作者还计划将 Transformer 扩展到文本以外的输入输出模态，并研究局部受限注意力机制以高效处理图像、音频和视频等大规模输入输出 [S7.p3]。
